scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/functions"
scripts.test:migrations: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only firestore "vitest run tests/migrations"
scripts.test:security: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run tests/rules tests/functions tests/migrations"
scripts.test:exchange-emulator: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && EXCHANGE_STRIPE_MOCK_MODE=1 EXCHANGE_DISABLE_USASPENDING=1 STRIPE_FOUNDING_PRICE_ID=price_test_exchange STRIPE_FOUNDING_PRODUCT_ID=prod_test_exchange STRIPE_EXPECTED_MODE=test APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions "npx vitest run tests/exchange"
scripts.test:browser:emulator: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && EXCHANGE_STRIPE_MOCK_MODE=1 EXCHANGE_DISABLE_USASPENDING=1 STRIPE_FOUNDING_PRICE_ID=price_test_exchange STRIPE_FOUNDING_PRODUCT_ID=prod_test_exchange STRIPE_EXPECTED_MODE=test APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hi-coworking --only auth,firestore,functions "npx playwright test"
scripts.verify:exchange: npm run test:exchange-unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:exchange-emulator && npm run lint && npm run build
